test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate tense form to fill in the blank.

Mohnish and Ravi ________ to Canada next month.
solution:
The most appropriate tense form to fill in the blank is ‘1’ i.e. are moving.
